paragraphs.text: A Briggs and Riley Weekender
paragraphs.translation: A 款  Briggs and Riley 周末旅行箱

paragraphs.text: A weekend suitcase that's sophisticated and unusually spacious for its type. The strong nylon outer fabric is water and abrasion resistant, so it should handle any knocks without showing signs of damage.
paragraphs.translation:
一款精致且在同类型中异常宽敞的周末旅行箱。
其坚固的尼龙外层面料具有防水和耐磨特性，因此能够承受任何碰撞而不显现损坏迹象。

paragraphs.text: B Mulberry Scotchgrain
paragraphs.translation: B 玛百莉 Scotchgrain 系列

paragraphs.text: Trimmed in brown leather, with gold details, this bag from the renowned fashion house is a truly indulgent buy. If you're investing this much in a suitcase then you'd better be planning an amazing holiday to go with it.
paragraphs.translation:
这款来自知名时尚品牌的手袋以棕色皮革镶边，饰以金色细节，确实是一种奢华消费。
如果你在行李箱上投入这么多钱，那么你最好计划一个精彩的假期来与之相配。

paragraphs.text: C Rimova Salsa
paragraphs.translation: C 款式：Rimova Salsa

paragraphs.text: A design you can trust, this case is built from super light polycarbonate and is incredibly solid.The built-in combination lock offers state-of-the-art security so you can travel with peace of mind.
paragraphs.translation:
这款行李箱设计可靠，采用超轻聚碳酸酯制成，极其坚固。
内置密码锁提供最先进的安全保障，让您安心出行。

paragraphs.text: D Tripp Holiday
paragraphs.translation: D 特里普假日系列

paragraphs.text: Simple and affordable, the Tripp range offers a great selection of tough cases.They also come in a huge range of cheerful colours that should go with anything you choose to put on, and you'll definitely be able to spot it on the luggage carousel at the airport.
paragraphs.translation:
简单且价格实惠，Tripp系列提供了多种坚固箱子的绝佳选择。
它们还有各种鲜艳的颜色，与你选择的任何衣物都能搭配，而且在机场行李传送带上你绝对能一眼认出它。

paragraphs.text: E Eastpak Tranverz Holdall
paragraphs.translation: E 东帕克·特兰维兹行李袋

paragraphs.text: For those who want something in between an annual holiday suitcase and a weekend bag, this is a fantastic compromise. With two wheels and a telescopic handle, the bag is guaranteed for 30 years. Did we mention it also comes in colourful leopard print?
paragraphs.translation:
对于那些想要介于年度假期行李箱和周末包之间产品的人来说，这是一个极好的折中选择。
这款包配备了两个轮子和一个伸缩手柄，享有30年质保。
我们有没有提到它还有彩色豹纹款式可选？

paragraphs.text: F Herschel Parcel
paragraphs.translation: F 赫尔舍尔包裹箱

paragraphs.text: From the brand behind some of today's most popular rucksacks, this suitcase really is a delight.Custom printed, with Herschel's signature leather toggles this well-crafted case is as cool, stylish and up to date as they come.
paragraphs.translation:
来自当今一些最受欢迎的背包品牌，这款行李箱确实令人愉悦。
定制印花，搭配赫舍尔标志性的皮革扣环，这款制作精良的行李箱酷炫、时尚且与时俱进。

paragraphs.text: G The Diplomat
paragraphs.translation: G 外交官

paragraphs.text: Travel in style with this beautiful suitcase that goes back to the days when trains ran on steam and air travel was leisurely. The leather case, part of the Steamline Luggage range, features roller wheels and a metal frame to hold it in shape.
paragraphs.translation:
带着这款优雅的手提箱时尚出行，它让人回想起火车以蒸汽为动力、航空旅行悠闲惬意的时代。
这款皮革手提箱属于Steamline Luggage系列，配备滚轮和金属框架以保持其形状。

paragraphs.text: THE OXFORD SCHOOL OF DRAMA
paragraphs.translation: 牛津戏剧学院

paragraphs.text: One-Year Acting Course
paragraphs.translation: 一年制表演课程

paragraphs.text: This is an intensive course which is designed for those who have completed their academic studies and have some theatre or film experience already. In order to be accepted you should be a high achiever, knowledgeable about the industry and determined to succeed.
paragraphs.translation:
这是一门为已完成学业且具备一定戏剧或电影经验的人设计的强化课程。
要获得录取，你应当是一名成绩优异者、对行业有深入了解，并有决心取得成功。

paragraphs.text: Term One : Technical classes in acting, voice, movement, applied movement and characterisation, music, singing, film, radio and professional development.The term finishes with an internal production given for tutors and students.
paragraphs.translation: 第一学期：开设表演、声音、动作、应用动作与角色塑造、音乐、歌唱、电影、广播及专业发展等技巧课程。学期以面向教师和学生呈现的一场内部剧目而告终。

paragraphs.text: Term Two : All technical classes continue from term one.There is an internal performance of a one-act play, the recording of an audio showreel at a professional studio and the Showcase Drama in front of an invited audience including casting directors and agents.
paragraphs.translation:
第二学期：所有技术课程从第一学期继续开始。
其中包括一部独幕剧的内部演出、在专业录音室录制音频作品集，以及面向包括选角导演和经纪人在内的受邀观众进行的戏剧展示表演。

paragraphs.text: Term Three : Technical classes continue with additional focus on audition technique, workshops and masterclasses.This term includes a public performance of a play outdoors in the grounds of Blenheim Palace, and the chance to act a short film recorded on location by a professional crew.
paragraphs.translation:
第三学期：技术课程继续开展，同时额外侧重于试镜技巧、工作坊和大师班。
本学期包括在布莱尼姆宫户外场地进行的一场公开戏剧演出，以及参与一部由专业团队实地拍摄的短片演出的机会。

paragraphs.text: How to Apply
paragraphs.translation: 如何申请

paragraphs.text: Entry to The Oxford School of Drama is by audition only and there are no academic requirements for any of our courses.
paragraphs.translation:
牛津戏剧学院
进入牛津戏剧学院仅通过试镜，并且我们的任何课程都没有学术要求。

paragraphs.text: Once we have received your application form and audition fee, we will email you with a date for your audition and further details about what to expect when you are here.
paragraphs.translation: 一旦我们收到你的申请表和试镜费用，我们将通过电子邮件告知你试镜的日期以及有关你来到这里后应预期什么的更多细节。

paragraphs.text: For your initial audition, you will need to prepare two contrasting speeches from plays, lasting no longer than two minutes.There will also be some group work for which you will need to wear loose, comfortable clothing.
paragraphs.translation:
对于你的初次试镜，你需要准备两段来自戏剧的对比性独白，每段时长不超过两分钟。
还会有一些小组活动，为此你需要穿着宽松舒适的衣服。

paragraphs.text: If you are applying from overseas, you will be able to submit your first audition by means of DVD, YouTube or link to a secure website. You will be invited to submit this once we have received your application form and audition fee. If you are successful in your first audition, you will be invited to attend future auditions here at the school.The school will provide a free bus from central Oxford for those attending auditions.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你是海外申请者，你可以通过DVD、YouTube或安全网站链接提交你的第一轮试镜。
一旦我们收到你的申请表和试镜费，你将被邀请提交这一材料。
如果你首轮试镜成功，你将被邀请参加在学校进行的后续试镜。
学校将为参加试镜的人提供从牛津市中心出发的免费巴士。

groups.instructions:
Questions 1 - 7
Look at the seven reviews of suitcases, A-G.
For which suitcase are the following statements true?
Write the correct Jetter, A-G , in boxes 1-7 on your answer sheet .
NB You may use any letter more than once.

questions.prompt: This suitcase is for those who wish to purchase expensive luggage.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“purchase expensive luggage”对应原文B段中的“truly indulgent buy”，该描述暗示这是一款价格昂贵的奢侈行李箱。此外，“renowned fashion house”也强化了其高端定位，因此适合希望购买昂贵行李的人，答案为B。
questions.reason: extract B clearly describes expensive luxury item
questions.location_analysis: B 提到 'truly indulgent buy'，暗示价格昂贵，对应想买昂贵行李的人。
questions.paraphrasing: expensive luggage -> truly indulgent buy
evidence: Trimmed in brown leather, with gold details, this bag from the renowned fashion house is a truly indulgent buy.

questions.prompt: This suitcase is the right one for people who like to follow the latest fashion.
questions.analysis: 题干中“follow the latest fashion”在F段中被表达为“as cool, stylish and up to date as they come”，说明这款行李箱紧跟潮流、时尚前卫。同时提到品牌以流行背包著称，进一步支持其时尚属性，因此答案为F。
questions.reason: extract about F emphasizes trendiness
questions.location_analysis: F 用 'stylish and up to date' 描述，符合追求最新时尚。
questions.paraphrasing: latest fashion -> stylish and up to date
evidence: this well-crafted case is as cool, stylish and up to date as they come.

questions.prompt: lt is easy to choose one of these suitcases to match most clothing.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“match most clothing”对应D段中“cheerful colours that should go with anything you choose to put on”，明确指出其颜色百搭，容易与各种衣物搭配，因此答案为D。
questions.reason: explicit match with clothing mentioned
questions.location_analysis: D 说颜色与任何衣物搭配，对应容易搭配衣服。
questions.paraphrasing: match most clothing -> go with anything you choose to put on
evidence: They also come in a huge range of cheerful colours that should go with anything you choose to put on

questions.prompt: The manufacturer is confident that this suitcase will last a long time.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“last a long time”在E段中通过“guaranteed for 30 years”体现，表明制造商对其耐用性有高度信心，因此答案为E。
questions.reason: 30-year guarantee indicates confidence in longevity
questions.location_analysis: E 承诺30年保修，体现制造商对耐用性的信心。
questions.paraphrasing: last a long time -> guaranteed for 30 years
evidence: the bag is guaranteed for 30 years.

questions.prompt: ltems in this suitcase will not be affected if it gets wet.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“not be affected if it gets wet”对应A段中“water and abrasion resistant”的描述，说明外层材料具有防水性能，能有效保护内部物品不受潮，因此答案为A。
questions.reason: water resistant directly addresses wet conditions
questions.location_analysis: A 提到防水外层，物品不会受潮。
questions.paraphrasing: gets wet -> water resistant
evidence: The strong nylon outer fabric is water and abrasion resistant

questions.prompt: This suitcase is of a useful, medium size.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“useful, medium size”在E段中被描述为“something in between an annual holiday suitcase and a weekend bag”，即介于大行李箱和周末包之间的尺寸，符合中等实用尺寸的定义，因此答案为E。
questions.reason: description implies medium size
questions.location_analysis: E 描述介于大行李箱和周末包之间，即中等尺寸。
questions.paraphrasing: medium size -> in between an annual holiday suitcase and a weekend bag
evidence: For those who want something in between an annual holiday suitcase and a weekend bag, this is a fantastic compromise.

questions.prompt: Those who want to be reminded of an earlier age of travel will like this suitcase.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“reminded of an earlier age of travel”对应G段中“goes back to the days when trains ran on steam and air travel was leisurely”，明确唤起对早期旅行时代的怀旧情感，因此答案为G。
questions.reason: nostalgic reference to earlier travel era
questions.location_analysis: G 提到蒸汽火车和悠闲航空旅行，唤起早期旅行时代。
questions.paraphrasing: reminded of earlier age -> goes back to the days when trains ran on steam and air travel was leisurely
evidence: Travel in style with this beautiful suitcase that goes back to the days when trains ran on steam and air travel was leisurely.

groups.instructions:
Questions 8 - 14
Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 2?
Choose TRUE if the statement agrees with the information given in the text, choose FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or choose NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt: Students can begin the one-year course without any previous involvement inacting.
questions.analysis: 题干称学生可“without any previous involvement in acting”开始课程，但原文明确要求申请者“have some theatre or film experience already”，说明必须具备相关经验，因此该陈述与原文矛盾，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: prerequisite explicitly states needing experience
questions.location_analysis: 原文要求已有剧院/电影经验，因此无经验不能开始。
questions.paraphrasing: some theatre or film experience already -> requires having experience
evidence: This is an intensive course which is designed for those who have completed their academic studies and have some theatre or film experience already.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文明确要求学生先前有表演经历，与题干说法矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文已直接否定题干说法，并非未提及相关信息。

questions.prompt: Students will act in a performance in front of their classmates at the end of the firstterm.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“in front of their classmates”对应原文中第一学期末的“internal production given for tutors and students”，其中“students”即包括同学，因此该陈述与原文一致，答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: students are among audience
questions.location_analysis: 第一学期末内部演出观众包括学生，对应同学。
questions.paraphrasing: classmates -> tutors and students
evidence: The term finishes with an internal production given for tutors and students.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确提到‘at the end of the firstterm’，与选项内容矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确提及了该信息，并非未给出。

questions.prompt: Family members may attend a performance during the second term.
questions.analysis: 题干询问家人是否可参加第二学期演出，但原文仅提到观众包括“casting directors and agents”，并未提及家庭成员是否被允许出席，因此文中无相关信息，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 未提及家人是否可参加。
questions.location_analysis: 原文只提casting directors and agents，未提家人，选NOT GIVEN。
questions.paraphrasing: family members -> 无对应
questions.keywords: family members may attend, inviting audience including casting directors and agents
evidence: the Showcase Drama in front of an invited audience including casting directors and agents.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及家庭成员是否可以在第二学期观看演出，无法判断为正确。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提供任何信息证明家庭成员不能观看，因此不能判定为错误。

questions.prompt: Students are required to make a film on their own in the last term of the course.
questions.analysis: 题干称学生需“make a film on their own”，但原文明确说明短片是由“a professional crew”在实地拍摄，学生只是参与表演，并非独立制作，因此该陈述与原文不符，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: students act in film produced by professionals, not own
questions.location_analysis: 第三学期未要求独立拍电影，而是有专业团队拍摄。
questions.paraphrasing: on their own -> additional focus on audition technique
questions.keywords: make a film on their own
evidence: the chance to act a short film recorded on location by a professional crew.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文矛盾，原文表明学生并非独自完成电影。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了相关信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: ln their first audition, candidates perform speeches they have worked on in advance.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“speeches they have worked on in advance”对应原文中“prepare two contrasting speeches from plays”，“prepare”即表示提前准备，因此该陈述与原文一致，答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: prepare implies advance work
questions.location_analysis: 首次试镜要求准备两个演讲，即提前准备。
questions.paraphrasing: worked on in advance -> prepare two contrasting speeches
questions.keywords: speeches they have worked on in advance
evidence: For your initial audition, you will need to prepare two contrasting speeches from plays, lasting no longer than two minutes.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 与原文中明确说明第一次试镜时表演事先准备好的演讲这一信息相矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文中并未提及任何关于第一次试镜表演演讲准备情况的其他信息，因此无法判断为错误。

questions.prompt: The Oxford School of Drama will send candidates details of local accommodation.
questions.analysis: 题干询问学校是否会提供住宿信息，但原文只提到“provide a free bus from central Oxford”，并未涉及住宿安排或相关信息，因此文中无此内容，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 未提及住宿细节。
questions.location_analysis: 原文只提供免费巴士，未提住宿信息，选NOT GIVEN。
questions.paraphrasing: accommodation -> 无对应
questions.keywords: details of local accommodation, free bus from central Oxford
evidence: The school will provide a free bus from central Oxford for those attending auditions.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 题干声称牛津戏剧学院会发送住宿详情，但原文未提及此信息，无法判断真假。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 题干信息在原文中无对应表述，无法确定其错误，因此不能判断为假。

questions.prompt: Overseas candidates can do all their auditions via a digital link.
questions.analysis: 题干称海外申请者可“do all their auditions via a digital link”，但原文明确指出只有“first audition”可通过数字方式提交，后续试镜需到校参加，因此该陈述与原文矛盾，答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: only first audition digital, not all
questions.location_analysis: 只有第一次试镜可通过数字方式，之后需到校。
questions.paraphrasing: all auditions -> invited to submit first audition by digital means
questions.keywords: all their auditions via a digital link
evidence: If you are applying from overseas, you will be able to submit your first audition by means of DVD, YouTube or link to a secure website.
If you are successful in your first audition, you will be invited to attend future auditions here at the school.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文矛盾，原文指出并非所有试镜都能通过数字链接进行。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文中有相关信息，并非未提及。

sentence_translations.translation: 这是一门为已完成学业且具备一定戏剧或电影经验的人设计的强化课程。

sentence_translations.sentence: In order to be accepted you should be a high achiever, knowledgeable about the industry and determined to succeed.
sentence_translations.translation: 要获得录取，你应当是一名成绩优异者、对行业有深入了解，并有决心取得成功。

sentence_translations.sentence: Term One : Technical classes in acting, voice, movement, applied movement and characterisation, music, singing, film, radio and professional development.The term finishes with an internal production given for tutors and students.
sentence_translations.translation: 第一学期：开设表演、声音、动作、应用动作与角色塑造、音乐、歌唱、电影、广播及专业发展等技巧课程。学期以面向教师和学生呈现的一场内部剧目而告终。

sentence_translations.sentence: Term Two : All technical classes continue from term one.
sentence_translations.translation: 第二学期：所有技术课程从第一学期继续开始。

sentence_translations.sentence: There is an internal performance of a one-act play, the recording of an audio showreel at a professional studio and the Showcase Drama in front of an invited audience including casting directors and agents.
sentence_translations.translation: 其中包括一部独幕剧的内部演出、在专业录音室录制音频作品集，以及面向包括选角导演和经纪人在内的受邀观众进行的戏剧展示表演。

sentence_translations.sentence: Term Three : Technical classes continue with additional focus on audition technique, workshops and masterclasses.
sentence_translations.translation: 第三学期：技术课程继续开展，同时额外侧重于试镜技巧、工作坊和大师班。

sentence_translations.sentence: This term includes a public performance of a play outdoors in the grounds of Blenheim Palace, and the chance to act a short film recorded on location by a professional crew.
sentence_translations.translation: 本学期包括在布莱尼姆宫户外场地进行的一场公开戏剧演出，以及参与一部由专业团队实地拍摄的短片演出的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to Apply
sentence_translations.translation: 如何申请

sentence_translations.sentence: Entry to The Oxford School of Drama is by audition only and there are no academic requirements for any of our courses.
sentence_translations.translation: 进入牛津戏剧学院仅通过试镜，并且我们的任何课程都没有学术要求。

sentence_translations.sentence: Once we have received your application form and audition fee, we will email you with a date for your audition and further details about what to expect when you are here.
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦我们收到你的申请表和试镜费用，我们将通过电子邮件告知你试镜的日期以及有关你来到这里后应预期什么的更多细节。

sentence_translations.sentence: For your initial audition, you will need to prepare two contrasting speeches from plays, lasting no longer than two minutes.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于你的初次试镜，你需要准备两段来自戏剧的对比性独白，每段时长不超过两分钟。

sentence_translations.sentence: There will also be some group work for which you will need to wear loose, comfortable clothing.
sentence_translations.translation: 还会有一些小组活动，为此你需要穿着宽松舒适的衣服。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are applying from overseas, you will be able to submit your first audition by means of DVD, YouTube or link to a secure website.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你是海外申请者，你可以通过DVD、YouTube或安全网站链接提交你的第一轮试镜。

sentence_translations.sentence: You will be invited to submit this once we have received your application form and audition fee.
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦我们收到你的申请表和试镜费，你将被邀请提交这一材料。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are successful in your first audition, you will be invited to attend future auditions here at the school.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你首轮试镜成功，你将被邀请参加在学校进行的后续试镜。

sentence_translations.sentence: The school will provide a free bus from central Oxford for those attending auditions.
sentence_translations.translation: 学校将为参加试镜的人提供从牛津市中心出发的免费巴士。

paragraphs.text: This Border Crossing Guide is designed for drivers and motor carriers operating commercial vehicles at Michigan's international border crossings. This information will help you cross the border from the U.S. into Canada, and from Canada into the US.
paragraphs.translation:
本边境通关指南专为在密歇根州国际边境口岸运营商用车辆的司机和运输公司设计。
这些信息将帮助您从美国进入加拿大，以及从加拿大进入美国。

paragraphs.text: Your first point of contact at the border consists of Primary Inspection. The best way to clear customs at Primary Inspection is to make sure Customs gets information about your shipment before you set off, using the Pre-Arrival Processing System(PAPS). When using this you need to provide information about your shipment, and you also need to send proof of a current annual inspection for your vehicle, tractor and trailer.
paragraphs.translation:
你在边境的第一个接触点是初级检查。
在初级检查处顺利通关的最佳方式是使用预到达处理系统，确保海关在出发前获取你货物信息。
使用该系统时，你需要提供货物信息，并且还需要提交车辆、牵引车和拖车当前年度检查的证明。

paragraphs.text: Before you arrive at the border, make sure you have all your paperwork up to date and ready to present at Primary Inspection. You'll need a photo ID in addition to your birth certificate or passport. Drivers must also turn on interior cab lights and open all interior drapes or blinds to sleeper areas for easy inspection.
paragraphs.translation:
在抵达边境之前，请确保您已将所有文件更新完毕，并准备好在一级检查处出示。
除了出生证明或护照外，您还需要携带带有照片的身份证件。
驾驶员还必须打开驾驶室内部灯光，并拉开卧铺区域的所有内部窗帘或百叶窗，以便进行便捷检查。

paragraphs.text: If all of your paperwork is in order and was processed ahead of time, you will be released at the primary lane and this may be your only stop. If you are not a Canadian or U.S. citizen, a visa is obligatory and you will also be required to complete an I-94 Card. I-94 Cards are available only at border crossings into the United States. Drivers who clear customs at Primary Inspection will be instructed to report to Immigration to fill out the I-94 Card and receive verbal clearance from a U.S. official to proceed into the United States.The charge for the I-94 Card is $6.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你所有的文件都齐全并且已经提前处理完毕，你将在主检查通道被放行，这可能就是你唯一需要停留的地方。
如果你不是加拿大或美国公民，签证是必须的，同时你还需要填写一份I-94卡。
I-94卡仅在美国入境口岸提供。
在主检查处完成通关的司机将被指示前往移民局填写I-94卡，并从美国官员那里获得口头许可，方可进入美国。
I-94卡的费用为6美元。

paragraphs.text: If your paperwork is not in order, you will be directed to Secondary Inspection. When you get there, look for the signs for Truck Inspection and follow these.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你的文件不符合要求，你将被引导至二次检查处。
到达那里后，寻找卡车检查标志并遵循指示。

paragraphs.text: Appendix: Dealing with absence in the workplace
paragraphs.translation: 附录：处理工作场所的缺勤问题

paragraphs.text: This appendix considers how to handle problems of absence and gives guidance about authorised and unauthorised absence of employees from work.
paragraphs.translation: 本附录探讨如何处理缺勤问题，并就员工经批准和未经批准的缺勤提供指导。

paragraphs.text: The organisation should be aware of the rights of employees and in particular the requirements of the Equality Act 2010 when making any decisions about absences of employees who are disabled. In these cases the employer should consider what reasonable adjustments could be made in the workplace to help the employee.This might be something as simple as supplying an appropriate chair for the use of the employee. In cases where an employee suffers from an allergy caused by something in the workplace, the employer should consider remedial action or a transfer to alternative work.
paragraphs.translation:
组织在决定残疾员工的缺勤问题时，应了解员工的权利，特别是《2010年平等法案》的要求。
在这些情况下，雇主应考虑在工作场所做出哪些合理调整以帮助该员工。
这可能简单到为员工提供一把合适的椅子。
如果员工因工作场所中的某种物质而过敏，雇主应考虑采取补救措施或将其调至其他工作岗位。

paragraphs.text: If the absence is because of temporary difficulties relating to dependants, the employee may be entitled to have time off under the provisions of the Employment Rights Act 1996. In cases where the employee has difficulty managing both work and home responsibilities, employees have the right to request flexible ways of working, such as job-sharing ,and employers must have a good business reason for rejecting any such application.
paragraphs.translation:
如果缺勤是由于与家属相关的暂时性困难，员工可能有权根据《1996年就业权利法案》的规定请假。
在员工难以兼顾工作和家庭责任的情况下，员工有权要求灵活的工作方式，例如工作分担，而雇主必须有合理的商业理由才能拒绝此类申请。

paragraphs.text: Employers should investigate unexpected absences promptly and the employee should be asked for an explanation at a return-to-work interview. in order to show both the employee concerned and other employees that absence is regarded as a serious matter and may result in dismissal, it is very important that persistent absence is dealt with firmly and consistently.Records showing lateness and the duration of and explanations for all spells of absence should be kept to help monitor levels of absence or lateness. If the employer wishes to contact the employee's doctor for more information about a medical condition, he or she must notify the employee in writing that they intend to make such an application and they must secure the employee's consent in writing. Consideration should be given to introducing measures to help employees, regardless of status or seniority, who may be suffering from stress. The aim should be to identify employees affected and encourage them to seek help and treatment.
paragraphs.translation:
雇主应及时调查意外的缺勤情况，并在返岗面试中要求员工做出解释。
为了向相关员工及其他员工表明缺勤被视为严重问题并可能导致解雇，坚定且一致地处理长期缺勤至关重要。
应保留显示迟到情况、所有缺勤期间的时长及解释的记录，以帮助监控缺勤或迟到的程度。
如果雇主希望联系员工的医生以获取更多关于健康状况的信息，必须书面通知员工其有意提出此类申请，并且必须获得员工的书面同意。
应考虑引入措施帮助可能承受压力的员工，无论其职位或资历如何。
目标应是识别受影响的员工，并鼓励他们寻求帮助和治疗。

sentence_translations.sentence: The best way to clear customs at Primary Inspection is to make sure Customs gets information about your shipment before you set off, using the Pre-Arrival Processing System(PAPS).
sentence_translations.translation: 在初级检查处顺利通关的最佳方式是使用预到达处理系统，确保海关在出发前获取你货物信息。

sentence_translations.sentence: When using this you need to provide information about your shipment, and you also need to send proof of a current annual inspection for your vehicle, tractor and trailer.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用该系统时，你需要提供货物信息，并且还需要提交车辆、牵引车和拖车当前年度检查的证明。

sentence_translations.sentence: Before you arrive at the border, make sure you have all your paperwork up to date and ready to present at Primary Inspection.
sentence_translations.translation: 在抵达边境之前，请确保您已将所有文件更新完毕，并准备好在一级检查处出示。

sentence_translations.sentence: You'll need a photo ID in addition to your birth certificate or passport.
sentence_translations.translation: 除了出生证明或护照外，您还需要携带带有照片的身份证件。

sentence_translations.sentence: Drivers must also turn on interior cab lights and open all interior drapes or blinds to sleeper areas for easy inspection.
sentence_translations.translation: 驾驶员还必须打开驾驶室内部灯光，并拉开卧铺区域的所有内部窗帘或百叶窗，以便进行便捷检查。

sentence_translations.sentence: If all of your paperwork is in order and was processed ahead of time, you will be released at the primary lane and this may be your only stop.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你所有的文件都齐全并且已经提前处理完毕，你将在主检查通道被放行，这可能就是你唯一需要停留的地方。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are not a Canadian or U.S. citizen, a visa is obligatory and you will also be required to complete an I-94 Card.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你不是加拿大或美国公民，签证是必须的，同时你还需要填写一份I-94卡。

sentence_translations.sentence: I-94 Cards are available only at border crossings into the United States.
sentence_translations.translation: I-94卡仅在美国入境口岸提供。

sentence_translations.sentence: Drivers who clear customs at Primary Inspection will be instructed to report to Immigration to fill out the I-94 Card and receive verbal clearance from a U.S. official to proceed into the United States.
sentence_translations.translation: 在主检查处完成通关的司机将被指示前往移民局填写I-94卡，并从美国官员那里获得口头许可，方可进入美国。

sentence_translations.sentence: The charge for the I-94 Card is $6.
sentence_translations.translation: I-94卡的费用为6美元。

sentence_translations.sentence: If your paperwork is not in order, you will be directed to Secondary Inspection.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你的文件不符合要求，你将被引导至二次检查处。

sentence_translations.sentence: When you get there, look for the signs for Truck Inspection and follow these.
sentence_translations.translation: 到达那里后，寻找卡车检查标志并遵循指示。

sentence_translations.sentence: Appendix: Dealing with absence in the workplace
sentence_translations.translation: 附录：处理工作场所的缺勤问题

sentence_translations.sentence: This appendix considers how to handle problems of absence and gives guidance about authorised and unauthorised absence of employees from work.
sentence_translations.translation: 本附录探讨如何处理缺勤问题，并就员工经批准和未经批准的缺勤提供指导。

sentence_translations.sentence: The organisation should be aware of the rights of employees and in particular the requirements of the Equality Act 2010 when making any decisions about absences of employees who are disabled.
sentence_translations.translation: 组织在决定残疾员工的缺勤问题时，应了解员工的权利，特别是《2010年平等法案》的要求。

sentence_translations.sentence: In these cases the employer should consider what reasonable adjustments could be made in the workplace to help the employee.
sentence_translations.translation: 在这些情况下，雇主应考虑在工作场所做出哪些合理调整以帮助该员工。

sentence_translations.sentence: This might be something as simple as supplying an appropriate chair for the use of the employee.
sentence_translations.translation: 这可能简单到为员工提供一把合适的椅子。

sentence_translations.sentence: In cases where an employee suffers from an allergy caused by something in the workplace, the employer should consider remedial action or a transfer to alternative work.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果员工因工作场所中的某种物质而过敏，雇主应考虑采取补救措施或将其调至其他工作岗位。

sentence_translations.sentence: If the absence is because of temporary difficulties relating to dependants, the employee may be entitled to have time off under the provisions of the Employment Rights Act 1996.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果缺勤是由于与家属相关的暂时性困难，员工可能有权根据《1996年就业权利法案》的规定请假。

sentence_translations.sentence: In cases where the employee has difficulty managing both work and home responsibilities, employees have the right to request flexible ways of working, such as job-sharing, and employers must have a good business reason for rejecting any such application.
sentence_translations.translation: 在员工难以兼顾工作和家庭责任的情况下，员工有权要求灵活的工作方式，例如工作分担，而雇主必须有合理的商业理由才能拒绝此类申请。

sentence_translations.sentence: Employers should investigate unexpected absences promptly and the employee should be asked for an explanation at a return-to-work interview.
sentence_translations.translation: 雇主应及时调查意外的缺勤情况，并在返岗面试中要求员工做出解释。

sentence_translations.sentence: in order to show both the employee concerned and other employees that absence is regarded as a serious matter and may result in dismissal, it is very important that persistent absence is dealt with firmly and consistently.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了向相关员工及其他员工表明缺勤被视为严重问题并可能导致解雇，坚定且一致地处理长期缺勤至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Records showing lateness and the duration of and explanations for all spells of absence should be kept to help monitor levels of absence or lateness.
sentence_translations.translation: 应保留显示迟到情况、所有缺勤期间的时长及解释的记录，以帮助监控缺勤或迟到的程度。

sentence_translations.sentence: If the employer wishes to contact the employee's doctor for more information about a medical condition, he or she must notify the employee in writing that they intend to make such an application and they must secure the employee's consent in writing.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果雇主希望联系员工的医生以获取更多关于健康状况的信息，必须书面通知员工其有意提出此类申请，并且必须获得员工的书面同意。

sentence_translations.sentence: Consideration should be given to introducing measures to help employees, regardless of status or seniority, who may be suffering from stress.
sentence_translations.translation: 应考虑引入措施帮助可能承受压力的员工，无论其职位或资历如何。

sentence_translations.sentence: The aim should be to identify employees affected and encourage them to seek help and treatment.
sentence_translations.translation: 目标应是识别受影响的员工，并鼓励他们寻求帮助和治疗。

parts.article_title: A visit to Oymyakon, the world's coldest town

paragraphs.text: A

You don't need a sat nav to drive to Oymyakon. From Yakutsk you cross the Lena River and simply follow the M56 almost all of the way before taking a left at Tomtor for the final few kilometres. The journey takes two days of hard driving; two days of glistening landscapes, frozen rivers and untouched snow; two days of endless forest and breathtaking beauty; two days to penetrate the heart of Siberia and reach the coldest inhabited place on Earth.The beauty surprised me. Siberia isn't known for its pleasant appearance. It's always billed as a place of hardship. But for hour after hour, the wintry wonderland was bathed in a crisp, clean sunshine,presenting a continuous panorama of conifer trees wreathed in silence and snow.
paragraphs.translation:
开车前往奥伊米亚康并不需要卫星导航。
从雅库茨克出发，越过勒拿河，几乎全程沿着M56公路行驶，在托姆托尔左转，再走最后几公里就到了。
这段旅程需要两天艰难的驾驶；两天里，景色晶莹闪烁，河流冰封，雪地无痕；两天里，是无尽的森林和令人屏息的美景；两天的时间，足以深入西伯利亚腹地，抵达地球上最寒冷的有人居住之地。
这种美丽让我感到惊讶。
西伯利亚并非以其宜人的外观而闻名。
它总被描绘成一片艰苦之地。
但一连几个小时，这片冬日仙境都沐浴在清新干净的阳光中，展现出一幅连绵的全景，针叶树被静默与白雪所环绕。

paragraphs.text: B

As we left the flat plain, the road began to twist and turn, leading us into untouched hills and on towards the Verkhoyansk Mountains. Beneath their snow-clad peaks,the slopes became steeper and the valleys deeper. Down in a valley, we stopped to look at a hot spring beside the road. It was immediately obvious against the snow- a spot shrouded in heavy mist. Trees emerged from the strange haze as ghostly silhouettes.
paragraphs.translation:
当我们离开平坦的平原时，道路开始蜿蜒曲折，引领我们进入未经开发的山丘，并继续朝着维尔霍扬斯克山脉前进。
在它们白雪覆盖的山峰之下，山坡变得更加陡峭，山谷也更深邃。
在下面的一个山谷里，我们停下来观看路边的温泉。
在雪的映衬下，它立刻变得显而易见——一个被浓雾笼罩的地方。
树木从奇特的雾霭中浮现，如同幽灵般的轮廓。

paragraphs.text: C

Despite the magical ambience of the Siberian wilderness, its reputation for hardship hit me every time I climbed out of the vehicle. Within less than a minute, the skin all over my face began to feel as if it were burning. If I wasn't wearing my two sets of gloves,I rapidly lost the feeling in my fingertips. I learned very quickly not to draw too deep a breath because the shock of the cold air in my lungs invariably set me off on an extended bout of coughing.Siberia in winter is a world barely fit for human habitation.This is a place of such searing cold that it bites through multiple layers of clothing as if they aren't there.
paragraphs.translation:
尽管西伯利亚荒野有着神奇的氛围，但每次我爬出车外时，它那以严酷著称的名声都让我切身体会到。
不到一分钟，我脸上的皮肤就开始感觉像在燃烧一样。
如果我没有戴两副手套，我的指尖会迅速失去知觉。
我很快就学会了不要深呼吸，因为冷空气进入肺部的冲击总会引发我一阵长时间的咳嗽。

paragraphs.text: D

Oymyakon is a quiet little town - the world's coldest- of about 550 inhabitants, with its own power station, a school, two shops and a small hospital. It probably originated as a seasonal settlement where reindeer herders spent the summer on the banks of the Indigirka River.

paragraphs.text: E

The temperature when I arrived was -45°C - not particularly cold, I was informed.A number of factors combine to explain Oymyakon's record low temperatures. It is far from the ocean,with its moderating effect on air temperature. In addition, the town sits in a valley, below the general level of the Oymyakon Plateau, which, in turn, is enclosed on all sides by mountains up to 2,000 metres in height. As the cold air sinks, it accumulates in the valley, with little wind to disturb it. Oymyakon's average temperature in January is -50℃.Lower temperatures have been recorded in Antarctica, but there are no permanent inhabitants there.
paragraphs.translation:
我到达时的气温是零下45摄氏度——我被告知这并不算特别冷。
多种因素共同解释了奥伊米亚康创纪录的低温。
它远离海洋，而海洋对气温具有调节作用。

paragraphs.text: F

Day-to-day life in Oymyakon presents certain challenges during the long winters. There are hardly any modern household conveniences. Water is hacked out of the nearby river as great chunks of ice and dragged home on a sledge. The giant ice cubes are stacked outdoors and carried into the house one at a time to melt when needed. The lack of running water also means no showers or baths, or indeed flushing toilets.Since 2008, the town's school has enjoyed the luxury of indoor toilets, however. It's one of the small number of civic buildings in the centre of town that are linked to the power station.
paragraphs.translation:
在奥伊米亚康的漫长冬季，日常生活面临着一些挑战。
几乎没有任何现代化的家庭便利设施。
人们从附近的河中砍下大块冰块，然后用雪橇拖回家。

然而，自2008年起，镇上的学校已经享有了室内厕所的奢侈待遇。

paragraphs.text: G

The power station provides winter heating in the form of hot water, but many houses lie outside its range and rely on their own wood-burning stove.Fuel is plentiful enough in the surrounding forest, but someone still has to venture out to cut the wood.Everybody in Oymyakon owns good boots, a hat made of animal fur and fur-lined mittens.The boots are usually made from reindeer hide, which is light but keeps your feet very warm - the individual hairs are hollow, like a thin tube with air inside.Since air is a poor conductor of heat, the skin makes excellent winter footwear,and felt soles give added insulation. Hats come in a variety of furs, including fox, raccoon, sable and mink.
paragraphs.translation:
发电站以热水的形式提供冬季供暖，但许多房屋不在其覆盖范围内，依靠自家的柴火炉取暖。
